lines.zh: 菌柄一弯，我就朝你挪过去了。
lines.en: My stalk bends and I shuffle toward you.

lines.zh: 秘境的地很软，我的脚陷下去。
lines.en: The Mysterium ground is soft; my feet sink in.

lines.zh: 我没有膝盖，走起来一颠一颠。
lines.en: I have no knees, so I bounce with every step.

lines.zh: 孢子在身后落成一条白线。
lines.en: Spores fall behind me in a pale line.

lines.zh: 我踩过自己的同类，没有停。
lines.en: I step over my own kind and do not stop.

lines.zh: 菌盖挡着视线，我只能闻方向。
lines.en: My cap blocks my sight; I follow only scent.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩碎几朵小蘑菇。
lines.en: Every step crushes a few small mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我步子沉，方向却错不了。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I never take a detour.

lines.zh: 土里的菌丝在替我数步子。
lines.en: The mycelium in the soil counts my steps.

lines.zh: 我这双脚是后来才长出来的。
lines.en: These feet of mine grew out only later.

lines.zh: 别站在我正前方，我不刹车。
lines.en: Do not stand in front of me; I cannot brake.

lines.zh: 秘境的风把我的孢子吹回来。
lines.en: The Mysterium wind blows my spores back at me.

lines.zh: 我站在菌毯上，慢慢鼓起菌盖。
lines.en: I stand on the fungal mat and slowly swell my cap.

lines.zh: 四十五颗心的重量，压得土响。
lines.en: Forty-five hearts of weight make the soil creak.

lines.zh: 我什么都不想，菌类不用想。
lines.en: I think nothing; fungi have no need to think.

lines.zh: 孢子在我头顶飘，像一层灰。
lines.en: Spores drift above my head like a layer of ash.

lines.zh: 我在等菌柄再结实一些。
lines.en: I am waiting for this body to harden a little more.

lines.zh: 秘境没有白天，我也分不清。
lines.en: Mysterium has no true day, and I cannot tell.

lines.zh: 有人踩过我的菌丝，我记住了。
lines.en: Someone trampled my mycelium, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖下面藏着九点力气。
lines.en: Under my cap I keep nine points of force.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我听见自己在长。
lines.en: The quiet lets me hear my own slow growth.

lines.zh: 我身上没有口袋，从来没有。
lines.en: I have no pockets on me, and never have.

lines.zh: 别的菌类都躲着我长。
lines.en: Other fungi grow away from me.

lines.zh: 我试着往回缩，缩不回土里。
lines.en: I try to shrink back, but the soil will not take me.

lines.zh: 湿气顺着菌柄往下走。
lines.en: Damp runs down the length of my stalk.

lines.zh: 这片菌毯记得我出生那天。
lines.en: This fungal mat remembers the day I was born.

lines.zh: 菌褶里积了水，我抖不掉。
lines.en: Water pools in my gills; I can't shake it.

lines.zh: 我站了很久，脚下的土软了。
lines.en: Standing so long, the soil softened.

lines.zh: 秘境的雾贴着我，我不动。
lines.en: Mystic fog clings to me; I don't move.

lines.zh: 有虫子在我脚边爬，随它。
lines.en: A bug crawls by my foot. Let it.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上沾着我的孢子。
lines.en: My spores are clinging to your boots.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，菌盖往后仰。
lines.en: I tilt my cap back to look up at you.

lines.zh: 你比这里的蘑菇高太多了。
lines.en: You stand far taller than any mushroom here.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一块新的腐木。
lines.en: I look at you the way I look at fresh rot.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸里有暖意，我不喜欢。
lines.en: There is warmth in your breath, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 你身上没有菌丝，真干净。
lines.en: You carry no mycelium at all, so clean.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，想先咬哪里。
lines.en: I stare at your feet and pick where to bite first.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我的菌盖在缩。
lines.en: You raise a torch, and my cap shrinks back.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的孢子。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my drifting spores.

lines.zh: 我看不清你的脸，但闻得到。
lines.en: I cannot see your face, but I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你站着像一根不会烂的柱子。
lines.en: You stand there like a pillar that will not rot.

lines.zh: 我记住你的味道了，别再靠近。
lines.en: I have your scent now; do not come closer.

lines.zh: 我掉了一块菌肉，还会再长。
lines.en: A piece of my flesh is gone; it will regrow.

lines.zh: 你砍在菌柄上，汁水溅出来。
lines.en: You strike my stalk and juice sprays out.

lines.zh: 疼是新的，我不太习惯。
lines.en: Pain is new to me, and I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 我的孢子被震得四处乱飞。
lines.en: The blow shakes my spores in every direction.

lines.zh: 你以为砍开我就结束了。
lines.en: You think cutting me open would finish it.

lines.zh: 菌盖裂了一道，我看得更清了。
lines.en: A crack splits my cap, and now I see better.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起出土那天。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of the day I broke soil.

lines.zh: 我不逃，我从来没学会逃。
lines.en: I do not flee; I never learned how.

lines.zh: 你的刀口在我身上很快合上。
lines.en: The cut you made closes quickly on me.

lines.zh: 反正我死后什么都不掉。
lines.en: It hardly matters; I drop nothing when I die.

lines.zh: 你手里那点食物，留着自己吃。
lines.en: I do not eat what you hold; I eat you.

lines.zh: 腐木比面包香，你不懂。
lines.en: Rotting wood smells better than bread; you would not know.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，我照样扑。
lines.en: Set the food down; I will lunge all the same.

lines.zh: 菌类只认土里的东西。
lines.en: Fungi only recognize what lies in the soil.

lines.zh: 那点甜味，菌丝都不肯吸。
lines.en: Even my mycelium refuses to drink that sweetness.

lines.zh: 我饿，但不吃活物的东西。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I eat nothing a living thing offers.

lines.zh: 你手里没有我要的湿气。
lines.en: What you hold lacks the dampness I want.

lines.zh: 收回去，别在我面前晃。
lines.en: Put it away; do not wave it in front of me.

lines.zh: 我这辈子没吃过一口好东西。
lines.en: In my whole life I have never eaten anything good.

lines.zh: 你以为一块面包能让我停手。
lines.en: You think a piece of bread would stay my hand.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的菌盖，蹭了一身孢子。
lines.en: You bump my cap and come away dusted with spores.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看上去软，也更重。
lines.en: My body is softer than it looks, and heavier.

lines.zh: 别推，我倒了就会压住你。
lines.en: Do not push; if I fall, I will pin you.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞得我菌柄一歪。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocks my stalk to one side.

lines.zh: 我被撞了，就会先动手。
lines.en: When I am struck, my hands move first.

lines.zh: 这一下我记在菌丝里了。
lines.en: I have written this touch into my mycelium.

lines.zh: 我们都不肯让，那就撞到底。
lines.en: Neither of us yields, so we collide until one breaks.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下来一块菌肉。
lines.en: A piece of my flesh drops off on impact.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我前进两步。
lines.en: You step back once, and I step forward twice.

lines.zh: 挤在一起时，我闻到你怕了。
lines.en: Pressed this close, I can smell your fear.

lines.zh: 我们不用靠近，孢子会碰头。
lines.en: We need not touch; our spores will meet in the air.

lines.zh: 我把孢子撒在风里，就这样。
lines.en: I scatter spores into the wind; that is all.

lines.zh: 你看见的两朵菌盖其实是一对。
lines.en: The two caps you see are in fact a pair.

lines.zh: 秘境里的菌毯都是我们的孩子。
lines.en: The fungal mats of Mysterium are all our children.

lines.zh: 我不筑巢，落地就是家。
lines.en: I build no nest; wherever I land is home.

lines.zh: 每年这个时候，菌盖都会张开。
lines.en: Around this time each year, my cap opens wide.

lines.zh: 我们交换的不是话，是孢子。
lines.en: What we exchange is not words but spores.

lines.zh: 这一片地的味道，像我母亲。
lines.en: The smell of this ground is like my mother's.

lines.zh: 我死后，菌丝还会继续长。
lines.en: After I die, my mycelium will keep spreading.

lines.zh: 两朵菌盖碰在一起，就算成家。
lines.en: Two caps brushing together count as a household.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，我根本没有手。
lines.en: I cannot pick it up; I have no hands at all.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，归菌毯。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground belongs to the fungal mat.

lines.zh: 你丢下的剑，我会踩进土里。
lines.en: The sword you drop, I will trample into the soil.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，也没打算长。
lines.en: I have no pockets and no plan to grow any.

lines.zh: 这堆东西挡着我，我踢开了。
lines.en: This heap blocks my path, so I kick it aside.

lines.zh: 菌类不收集，只分解。
lines.en: Fungi do not collect things; we break them down.

lines.zh: 那块铁在我脚下开始生锈。
lines.en: That iron begins to rust beneath my foot.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，什么都不会剩。
lines.en: Wherever my feet pass, nothing at all is left.

lines.zh: 你把东西放地上，我就忘了它。
lines.en: Leave it on the ground and I will forget it.

lines.zh: 我不需要带着战利品走。
lines.en: I have no need to carry any trophy away.

lines.zh: 我闻到你，你就成了目标。
lines.en: I catch your scent, and you become the target.

lines.zh: 菌丝在土里收紧，告诉我位置。
lines.en: My mycelium tightens in the soil and tells me where.

lines.zh: 你动了一下，我就锁定了。
lines.en: You moved once, and I have locked on.

lines.zh: 九点力气，够把你打翻在地。
lines.en: Nine points of force is enough to floor you.

lines.zh: 秘境里没有别的东西值得追。
lines.en: In Mysterium nothing else is worth chasing.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，不快，但不停。
lines.en: I come at you at a slow, unbroken pace.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声比孢子好认。
lines.en: Your footsteps are easier to follow than spores.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，菌盖已经转向。
lines.en: I have seen you; my cap has already turned.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑热了更好闻。
lines.en: Do not run; running makes your scent stronger.

lines.zh: 我选了你，就不会换别的。
lines.en: I have chosen you, and I will not switch.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，一步都不落下。
lines.en: I follow you and never lose a single step.

lines.zh: 你的背影在前面，我记住了。
lines.en: Your back is ahead of me, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我的孢子先到，我随后就来。
lines.en: My spores arrive first; I come right after.

lines.zh: 你拐弯，我也跟着拐。
lines.en: You turn a corner, and I turn it too.

lines.zh: 整片菌毯都在替你看着我。
lines.en: The whole fungal mat is watching you for me.

lines.zh: 你越跑越远，我越走越稳。
lines.en: The farther you run, the steadier I walk.

lines.zh: 我不喊，我的脚步就是喊。
lines.en: I do not shout; my footsteps are the shout.

lines.zh: 你回头看一眼吧，我在后面。
lines.en: Glance back once; I am behind you.

lines.zh: 菌柄里的水在催我快点。
lines.en: The water in my stalk pushes me to hurry.

lines.zh: 追上你之前，我不会停。
lines.en: Until I catch you, I will not stop.

lines.zh: 我这一下打在你肋骨上。
lines.en: This blow of mine lands on your ribs.

lines.zh: 菌盖砸下去，声音很闷。
lines.en: My cap slams down with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 九点力气的重量，慢慢体会。
lines.en: Take your time feeling nine points of force.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，身体就够了。
lines.en: I need no weapon; this body is enough.

lines.zh: 打中你时，我掉了一片菌肉。
lines.en: When I hit you, a slice of my flesh falls away.

lines.zh: 你退，我的第二下已经来了。
lines.en: You retreat, but my second blow has already come.

lines.zh: 我打得慢，但每下都很实。
lines.en: I strike slowly, but every hit lands solid.

lines.zh: 你听见菌柄绷紧的声音了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear my stalk pull taut?

lines.zh: 我的攻击不需要理由。
lines.en: My attacks do not require a reason.

lines.zh: 这一拳，是四十五颗心换的。
lines.en: This punch was paid for with forty-five hearts.

lines.zh: 土里鼓起一个包，然后是我。
lines.en: The soil bulges, and then there is me.

lines.zh: 我从一片菌毯的边缘站起来。
lines.en: I rise at the edge of a fungal mat.

lines.zh: 孢子聚拢，菌柄一节节长高。
lines.en: Spores gather and my stalk grows joint by joint.

lines.zh: 秘境给了我身体，也给了我饿。
lines.en: Mysterium gave me a body, and hunger with it.

lines.zh: 四周的蘑菇朝我这边歪过来。
lines.en: The mushrooms around me lean in my direction.

lines.zh: 我出生时，脚先踩碎了两朵菌。
lines.en: At my birth, my feet crushed two fungi first.

lines.zh: 这里湿，所以我在这里。
lines.en: It is damp here, so here I am.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，是土的味道。
lines.en: My first breath tasted of soil.

lines.zh: 你听见菌丝断裂吗，我醒了。
lines.en: Hear the mycelium snap? That is me waking.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里长出来，带着九点力气。
lines.en: I grow out of shadow, carrying nine points of force.

lines.zh: 没有谁生我，土自己让了位。
lines.en: No one birthed me; the soil simply made room.

lines.zh: 菌盖张开的那一刻，我认得路了。
lines.en: The moment my cap opens, I know the way.

lines.zh: 火一碰，我的菌盖就卷起来。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my cap curls shut.

lines.zh: 落地时我摔成了一摊软肉。
lines.en: I hit the ground and splash into soft flesh.

lines.zh: 水灌进菌柄，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water fills my stalk and I cannot float.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的孢子全掀走了。
lines.en: The blast strips every spore off me.

lines.zh: 箭钉在菌盖上，像一根刺。
lines.en: The arrow buries itself in my cap like a thorn.

lines.zh: 那股药味让我的菌丝缩紧。
lines.en: That potion smell makes my mycelium clench.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，土也变干了。
lines.en: When I starve, the soil itself dries up.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的菌盖焦了半边。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and half my cap is scorched.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我只能飘着。
lines.en: There is no soil in the void; I can only drift.
